note: Rewritten from Fauna Sinica, Insecta vol. 17, Isoptera; the original is in Chinese, and the original description is that of Gao, Zhu et Han 1981 (Entomotaxonomia 3(2): 138—140). In the soldier measurement table the three values "pronotum length 0.63—0.61", "labrum width 0.40—0.40" and "anterior width of the postmentum 0.25—0.25" are reversed or repeated in the book and are transcribed here unchanged; in the alate measurement table "ocellus width 0.11—0.50" clearly contradicts its mean of 0.13 and is suspected to be a misprint for 0.11—0.15, and is likewise transcribed as printed. The antennae of the specimens are incomplete and the original gives no number of antennal segments.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish yellow, the pre-frontal area slightly darker, clypeus pale brown, labrum brown, mandibles nearly black with the base slightly paler, postmentum brownish yellow with the lateral edges of the anterior part darker and the tip pale, antennae pale brownish yellow with the basal segments slightly darker, pronotum brownish yellow, mesonotum pale brownish yellow, femora pale yellow, the tibiae and tarsi seemingly slightly darker. The head bears sparse long and short hairs, the clypeus several short hairs, the anterior margin of the labrum 8—10 rather long hairs, the base of the mandibles some short fine hairs, and the margins of the pronotum generally short, sparse hairs while its surface bears several long hairs. The head is rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, widest at the eye spots behind the antennae, the eye spots pale brown, the anterolateral corners forming small rounded reddish brown projections, the posterolateral corners broadly arcuate, the posterior margin broadly curved outwards; the frons is sloping and slightly concave in the middle, the frontal ridges separate and slightly raised; the labrum is broadly oval, reaching 2/3 of the mandibles; the mandibles are stout with a swollen base, the left mandible with 4 marginal teeth (the first marginal tooth directed forwards, the second closer to the first and directed inwards, the third more distant from the first two and triangular, the fourth short, small and indistinct), the right mandible with the first marginal tooth slightly before the middle, more pointed and slightly forward, the second marginal tooth larger, and the anterior cutting edge with a larger convex arc than the posterior one; the postmentum is narrow and long, broadened over its anterior half; the antennae have 12—13 segments, segment 2 longer than segments 3 and 4, segment 3 the shortest; the pronotum is kidney-shaped and slightly narrower than the head, bent ventrally at the sides, its anterior margin shallowly arcuate with a slight notch in the middle, the lateral margins arcuately projecting, the posterior margin broadly arcuate without a median notch; the mesonotum is slightly narrower than the pronotum, the metanotum slightly wider than the mesonotum and slightly narrower than the pronotum; both the mesonotum and the metanotum have small wing pads at the sides, the fore wing pads slightly larger than the hind ones. Measurements: head length (with mandibles) 3.25—3.42 mm, head length (to the base of the mandibles) 2.35—2.51 mm, head width at the antennal bases 1.30—1.36 mm, maximum head width 1.41—1.50 mm, maximum head height (excluding the postmentum) 1.33—1.36 mm, labrum length 0.37—0.41 mm, labrum width 0.40—0.40 mm, length of the left mandible 1.10—1.05 mm, distance from the first marginal tooth of the left mandible to its tip 0.15—0.18 mm, postmentum length 1.61—1.77 mm, anterior width of the postmentum 0.25—0.25 mm, maximum width of the postmentum 0.48—0.50 mm, minimum width of the postmentum 0.20—0.25 mm, pronotum length 0.63—0.61 mm, pronotum width 1.35—1.38 mm, hind femur length 0.90—0.95 mm, hind femur width 0.38—0.45 mm, hind tibia length 0.90—0.96 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brownish yellow, labrum brownish yellow, anteclypeus pale brownish yellow, postclypeus darker, mandibles black, antennae brownish yellow, compound eyes nearly blackish brown, pronotum brownish yellow, mesonotum and metanotum greyish brown with a dark mid-longitudinal line on their anterior half, wing scales reddish brown, coxae, trochanters and femora pale yellowish brown with the tibiae slightly darker, abdominal tergites brownish yellow and sternites slightly paler. The head bears very few hairs; the anterior margin of the labrum has about 10 short hairs, the surface of the labrum and clypeus a few hairs, the lateral margins of the posterior part of the postmentum short hairs and its surface more than 6 rather long hairs, the margins of the pronotum many short hairs, sparser in the middle of the posterior margin, with a few longer hairs mixed in at the lateral margins, and the posterior margins of the abdominal tergites also bear many short hairs. The head is nearly square, its length about equal to its width, the Y-suture indistinct and faintly visible; the frons is flat; the labrum is square, about 2/3 as long as wide, its anterior margin straight, its surface arched; the anteclypeus is trapezoidal, about 1/4 as long as wide; the postclypeus is short and broad; the anterior part of the postmentum is narrower than the posterior, concave in the middle of the anterior part, and its widest point lies behind the middle of the posterior part, about 1/2 of the postmentum length; the compound eyes are rather large, oval and distinctly projecting; the ocelli are oval and projecting, adjacent to but not touching the compound eyes; the antennae of the specimens are incomplete, in most individuals segment 2 is slightly larger than segment 3 and segments 3 and 4 appear equal in length. In most individuals the pronotum is as wide as the head (with compound eyes) or slightly narrower, its anterior margin strongly concave, its posterior margin straight and slightly concave, the middle of the anterior and posterior margins apparently without a distinct notch; the mesonotum and metanotum are both narrower than the pronotum. The fore wing scale is large and the hind wing scale small, about 1/2 of the fore wing scale, the fore wing scale covering most of the hind wing scale. Legs: the tibiae bear 3 apical spurs. The abdomen is cylindrical. Measurements (range / mean): head length to the tip of the labrum 1.69—1.80 (1.74) mm, head length to the base of the mandibles 1.25—1.50 (1.39) mm, head width with eyes 1.46—1.54 (1.51) mm, labrum length 0.35—0.40 (0.39) mm, postmentum length 0.73—0.85 (0.80) mm, maximum width of the postmentum 0.40—0.41 (0.40) mm, long diameter of the compound eye 0.49—0.51 (0.50) mm, short diameter of the compound eye 0.42—0.45 (0.44) mm, ocellus length 0.15—0.19 (0.17) mm, ocellus width 0.11—0.50 (0.13) mm, median length of the pronotum 0.72—0.79 (0.76) mm, pronotum width 1.41—1.56 (1.49) mm, hind femur length 1.04—1.15 (1.09) mm, hind femur width 0.40—0.43 (0.41) mm, hind tibia length 1.20—1.35 (1.27) mm. Host: Salix babylonica L. Distribution: Sichuan (Chengdu).
